WELCOME!

Falling Sun Ranch is our family’s home and our heart — a regenerative grazing farm nestled on 156 acres in Bonne Terre, Missouri, where caring for our land and raising animals sustainably and ethically means everything to us. What began as a simple desire — to raise food we could trust and proudly serve our own family — has grown into a passion for sharing that same honest, pasture-raised quality with yours.

SEE OUR STORY
WHAT WE DO

We farm regeneratively — rotating our cattle, caring for our soil, and giving every animal the space and respect it deserves. No shortcuts, no crowded barns — just honest food raised with love. Our cattle roam fresh pastures, our pigs and chickens forage freely, and every product we offer — from beef to pork to chicken and eggs — is raised naturally, responsibly, and with gratitude.

OUR PRACTICES

Rotational grazing is at the heart of our farm. These practices are rooted in respect for the land, for the animals, and for the families we feed. Our animals live on fresh pasture, never in the same place for long, giving each patch of pasture time to recover and grow richer. Over time, we’ve watched our soil come back to life, our grasses grow deeper roots, and our animals flourish. This regenerative approach heals the land, nurtures healthier animals, and helps us raise honest, wholesome food we’re proud to share.

BEEF PACKAGES
WE OFFER

At Falling Sun Ranch, we know that the best beef comes from a life well lived. That’s why we pride ourselves on raising happy, healthy cattle in a stress-free, nutritious environment. Our cattle are born, raised, and grass-fed in open pastures without the use of synthetic hormones. This results in tender, flavorful beef that you can feel good about consuming. Our bulk beef shares are available in quarter, half, and whole cow packages.

Our commitment to ensuring our beef is of the highest quality means that we are dedicated to partnering with another small business that shares our same standards. We're proud to work with another local, family-owned USDA and Missouri state inspected processor to continue the level of excellence we strive for.

Order your farm-fresh beef today and taste the difference!

ABOUT US
OUR STORY

Our story began with just 2 cow-calf pairs and a simple dream to raise food we could trust and feel proud to feed our own family. What started small quickly grew into something deeper: a calling to share that same wholesome, naturally-raised quality with other families. And that’s how Falling Sun Ranch truly came to life.

We wanted a name that honored the beauty of this place we call home, where the sky is endless and every sunset feels like a gift. Those falling rays of the evening light quickly felt like a part of our story — a reminder of the land’s quiet magic — and the name Falling Sun Ranch fit in every way.

Since those early days, our farm family has grown to more than 130 cows, pigs, egg-laying hens, and meat chickens. And three unofficial mascots — Gary the Goose, Tommy the Turkey, and Patrick the Peacock — because every farm needs a little personality.

For us, this isn’t just farming. It’s protecting our land, treating our animals with respect, and feeding our community real, honest food we believe in.

From our family to yours, welcome to the ranch. We’re grateful you’re here.

OUR PRODUCTS
GRASS-FED & GRAIN-FINISHED BEEF

Falling Sun Ranch’s grass-fed and grain-finished beef combines regenerative grazing with compassionate care. Our cattle graze nutrient-rich pastures via rotational grazing and receive a quality grain finish, yielding tender, flavorful beef with consistent marbling. Raised without hormones in a low-stress environment, our beef is wholesome, delicious, and supports responsible land stewardship. Available in bulk packages or individual cuts.

SHOP ONLINE
GRASS-FED & FINISHED BEEF

Falling Sun Ranch’s grass-fed and grass-finished beef comes from cattle raised on regenerative pastures through rotational grazing. This method provides healthy forage, enriches soil, and supports natural growth, producing nutrient-dense beef with a rich, pasture flavor. Our cattle live outdoors, free of hormones, cared for daily, and raised with low-stress handling for wholesome, flavorful beef grounded in responsible land stewardship. Available in bulk packages or individual cuts.

SHOP ONLINE
PASTURE-RAISED CHICKEN

Falling Sun Ranch chicken is raised with care and regenerative principles. Our birds have fresh air, open space, and natural foraging for their health. With clean feed, pasture access, and stress-free care, they grow naturally — never with hormones. The result is tender, flavorful chicken you can trust, raised responsibly and with a commitment to healthy land and happy animals.

SHOP ONLINE
LOCALLY-RAISED PORK

Falling Sun Ranch’s pork is raised with care from start to finish. They spend their days rooting in the dirt, soaking up sunshine, and living naturally. No growth hormones — just good feed and daily attention. It’s pork that’s local, flavorful, and wholesome.

SHOP ONLINE
FARM-FRESH EGGS

Falling Sun Ranch eggs come from hens raised with regenerative care, fresh pasture, natural foraging, and sunshine. They produce nutrient-rich eggs with vibrant yolks and clean flavor. Without hormones and stress, our hens thrive, reflected in every trusted carton.
